create_cached_assets_path: create a cached assets path for a library with a namespace and subfolder under the huggingface assets cache directory
build_cache_directory: build a cache directory path for arbitrary files using library name, namespace, and subfolder hierarchy
test_cached_assets_path: test the cached_assets_path function with default namespace and subfolder parameters
refactor_cached_assets_path: refactor the cached_assets_path function to sanitize special characters in library name, namespace, and subfolder
summarize_cached_assets_path: summarize the cached_assets_path function that returns a guaranteed-existing directory path for downstream library asset caching
